channel.title: Violations Watch: Nepal
channel.description: New incidents reported in Nepal. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Kathmandu police arrest film journalist Shalikram Nyaupane and two others over a social media video in which a woman claimed to be the Home Minister's mother, holding them on a privacy complaint (Setopati)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Kathmandu, Bagmati Province, Nepal. Types: Attacks on journalists, Arbitrary detention & disappearance. Alleged perpetrator: Kathmandu District Police Range. Disputed or caveats: Police say the arrest followed a privacy complaint; a later headline suggests he may have been released. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1293
